scope: Synthetic resource only; no actual train/test rows, accuracy, CV or upload
retrieval: Independent subclass overrides only _get_faiss_knn_indices. Official train-only SimpleImputer and StandardScaler produce self.X_train/self.X_test. Float64 explicit squared differences summed perfeature; blocks8; stable argsort by distance then original training position. Labels never enter distance. No approximate search.
source: Original frozen TabDPT1.3 vendor/CompactEncoder/fit/preprocess/network remain unchanged. faiss may be imported transitively but no native search/index/thread API is invoked by this path.

probe.actual_forward: For every batch assert257 x tokens and256 y labels; exact input values, independent lexsort neighbor IDs, and source training label indexing match returned NumPy neighbors

cost.qualification: All correctness checks and cost limit pass; root separately activates single-fold diagnostic, not automatic

persistence: Predictor stores only CPU encoder/support/labels/IDs/provenance/settings and scalar/JSON observations; rebuilds engine from pinned local weights each prediction; no GPU engine cached
failures: Preserve independent failed result; no K/view/precision/OMP fallback, no download or environment change
limitations: New256/1 recipe, not rescue or equivalence claim for prior2048/8 FAISS failure.
Float64 arithmetic and explicit tie ordering can differ from FAISS float32 search; only exact declared NumPy metric is claimed.
Small32query timings extrapolate query-specific forward work, not a guaranteed real-fold runtime.
Training pool8693 is searchable but each network context is256; no claim of full8693 attention context.
Synthetic success does not imply real-data accuracy or independent group transfer.
